newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end feebly, but well off lows.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end feebly, but well off lows.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended feebly on Thursday but well off their lows as cautious market participants waited for the December futures and options settlement on Friday, brokers said. They said Wall Street's sharp sell-off overnight dampened sentiment.
The Nikkei 225 closed at 20,501.20, down 67.18 points or 0.33 percent. Its December futures were down 50 points at 20,520.
"The market wants to see how the U.S. markets recover later today and how the settlement goes tomorrow," Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager said.
